A certificate with "allowances": null therefore verifies as VALID_UNVERIFIED, while the browser verifier and the published contract reject it.

findings.message: The source distribution excludes licenses/*.json because the manifest only includes *.md and *.txt. A wheel built from that sdist therefore has no licenses/terms.json (or issued.json), so license_terms.load_registry() and every certificate verification fail after installation. The wheel built directly from the checkout hides this because the build hook copies the JSON files. Include *.json and ext

The certificate digest is untrusted text, but hmac.compare_digest raises TypeError for a non-ASCII string. A certificate with a digest such as 'é' repeated 64 times crashes verify_certificate instead of returning TAMPERED, so the public verifier can be stopped by a malformed file. Compare UTF-8 bytes (surrogatepass for lone surrogates) or validate the digest as 64 hex characters first.
